summary: 78-year-old Denver woman overdue cross-country skiing at YMCA Snow Mountain Ranch; found deceased in deep snow after a Friday-night search.
location: YMCA Snow Mountain Ranch (Nordic Center), Grand County
notes: Overdue 78-year-old Denver woman last seen Thursday 2020-02-13 ~3pm near the Nordic Center in blizzard-like conditions. Notified Friday 2020-02-14 4:44pm. 14 GCSAR members + YMCA employees, 7 teams, cell-phone forensics via Civil Air Patrol/CSAR. Found deceased in deep snow near small trees at 9:30pm Friday; mission wrapped 1:00am Saturday. Coroner investigation.
